title: ExecutionPlan
description: Concrete transactions, produced by a venue adapter (Lane D) and executed by the vault (Lane A). THIS IS THE SEAM THAT KEEPS LANES A AND D APART: Lane D builds arbitrary calldata off-chain and never touches contracts/; Lane A's vault exposes one generic allowlisted execute(target, value, data) and never learns what a venue is. A third venue is a new adapter, not a contract change.

venue.description: Registry key of the adapter that produced this plan.

steps.description: Executed in order, each via the vault's execute(). If one reverts the tick fails; adapters must order approvals before the calls that need them.

expected_effect.description: Plain-language summary shown in the decision feed, e.g. 'swap 1,000 USDC for ~0.31 WETH'.

expected_slippage_bps.description: Adapter's estimate. The harness rejects the plan if this exceeds mandate.constraints.max_slippage_bps.

quote_expires_at.description: Router quotes go stale. The harness must not submit a plan past this.

target.description: MUST be on the vault's allowlist {Aqua, SwapVM, Uniswap UniversalRouter, Permit2, WETH} or execute() reverts.

calldata.description: ABI-encoded call. Opaque to the vault.

why.description: Per-step human explanation, e.g. 'approve Permit2 for USDC'. Makes the decision feed readable and makes a failed step diagnosable.
